items.title: 18.1 Quantum theory of radiation (shuaon ki quantum theory) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.1, quantum theory of radiation and the photon (PDF 119, printed 115).

blocks.text: 1901 mein Max Planck ne kaha ke energy lagataar wave ki shakal mein nahi, balke alag alag chhote packets mein radiate (kharij) ya absorb (jazb) hoti hai. In packets ko quanta kehte hain; quanta plural (jama) hai aur ek packet ko quantum kehte hain. Har quantum ek hi frequency ki radiation se juda hota hai. Har quantum ki energy E us ki frequency f ke directly proportional (barabar nisbat mein) hoti hai:
Yahan h Planck's constant hai; is ki value 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s hai. Yani frequency jitni zyada, ek quantum ki energy utni zyada.
Energy quanta ki discovery (daryaft) par Max Planck ko 1918 mein physics ka Nobel Prize mila.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: h quantum theory ka ek ahem constant hai. Doosra ahem constant roshni ki speed c hai, jo special theory of relativity ka constant hai.

Planck ne socha ke jaise matter (maddah) lagataar nahi balke bohat se nanhe particles se bana hai, isi tarah kisi source se nikalne wali radiation energy bhi granular (daane daane wali) hai. Un ke khayal mein garam cheezon ki radiation ki yeh particle wali nature (fitrat) un atoms ki kisi property (khasiyat) ki wajah se thi jo radiation paida karte hain. Einstein ne yeh khayal aage barhaya: energy ke yeh chhote bundles har electromagnetic radiation ka hissa hain aur inhein aur chhote hisson mein sub-divide (taqseem) nahi kiya ja sakta. In na tootne wale bundles ko unhon ne "photons" kaha. Wavelength λ wali roshni ki beam photons ki ek stream (dhaara) hai jo speed c se chalti hai, aur har photon ki energy E = hf hai.
Theory of relativity se E = mc², aur photon ka relativistic momentum p = mc hai. In dono ko milayen (mc² = (mc)c = pc) to:
E = hf rakhein to pc = hf, yani p = hf/c. Ab c = fλ hai, is liye f/c = 1/λ:

blocks.latex: \text{Thus}\quad pc = hf \quad\text{or}\quad p = hf/c \qquad \text{Since}\quad c = f\lambda,\quad \text{therefore,}
blocks.text_alt: Thus pc = hf or p = hf/c. Since c = fλ, therefore,

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Photon ka koi rest mass nahi, phir bhi us ke paas momentum p = E/c = h/λ hota hai. Isi liye roshni jis surface (satah) par parti hai us par halki si force (aur pressure) laga sakti hai. Wavelength chhoti ho to momentum zyada.

Quantum theory har system par lagayi ja sakti hai, maslan spring par oscillate karta (jhoolta) mass. Lekin wahan energy ke steps itne chhote hain ke detect (pakde) nahi kiye ja sakte, is liye particle wali nature nazar nahi aati. Quantum effects (asraat) sirf atom jitni chhoti cheezon mein ahem hain, jahan energy ki har measurable (napi ja sakne wali) tabdeeli mein h ka hissa significant (numayan) hota hai.

blocks.prompt: 600 nm wavelength wale photon ki energy aur momentum nikalein.

items: Planck (1901): energy quanta mein, E = hf (18.1), h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s.
Einstein: roshni photons ki stream; photon toota nahi ja sakta.
Photon ka momentum: E = pc (18.2), p = h/λ (18.3).
Quantum effects sirf atom jitni cheezon mein nazar aate hain.
